id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying syncs pointed at a sonarqube cloud host

review.posthog_relevance: Adds error handling and documentation for SonarQube Cloud ingestion configuration, preventing configuration errors between self-hosted and Cloud sources.
review.reason: Adds two new non-retryable error mappings and their corresponding 400 Bad Request messages to the SonarQube source, alongside documentation and a new test. This prevents the SonarQube self-hosted ingestion source from attempting to connect to SonarQube Cloud hosts, which would fail due to missing required parameters.
